jurisdictions.name: Lexington / Fayette County
jurisdictions.office: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government, Division of Building Inspection
notes: An in-ground pool needs a Swimming Pool Permit from the Division of Building Inspection. Fayette County Health Department approval is also required before the permit is issued.
The online application needs a site plan showing lot, fence, easements, existing structures, the proposed pool, walkways and distances to property lines, plus a subdivision plat or mortgage survey.
The fence must be shown on the site plan: at least 4 ft high, no openings over 4 inches, with self-closing, self-latching gates that open outward.
Residential pools are regulated under the 2018 Kentucky Residential Code. Easements need encroachment agreements, and floodplain sites need a special permit from the Division of Engineering.

sources.title: Permit Guide For Swimming Pools (Lexington Building Inspection, 2026)
